name: Determination of the Strange Quark Content of the Nucleon from a Next-to-Leading-Order QCD Analysis of Neutrino Charm Production

summary.plain: Using about 6,000 events with two muons from the CCFR detector, the first next-to-leading-order QCD analysis of neutrino charm production found that strange quarks make up only about half as much of the proton's sea as the up and down antiquarks, and gave a measurement of the quark-mixing element V_cd.
summary.technical: NLO QCD analysis of 6090 opposite-sign dimuon events: kappa = 0.477 (+0.063 -0.053), charm mass m_c = 1.70 +- 0.19 GeV, |V_cd| = 0.232 (+0.018 -0.020).

title: Determination of the Strange Quark Content of the Nucleon from a Next-to-Leading-Order QCD Analysis of Neutrino Charm Production
why_it_matters: A key input to global parton-distribution fits and to the CKM element V_cd.
